# AILEARN

> AILEARN is an offline-first, adaptive AI learning platform engineered for secondary education. It enables students to study curriculum subjects, take adaptive diagnostic assessments, practice active recall flashcards, and interact with an offline AI study companion without requiring constant internet access.

## Core Capabilities
- **100% Offline Learning**: Full local client-side operation powered by Progressive Web App (PWA) service workers, IndexedDB (Dexie.js), and offline heuristic AI tutoring.
- **Adaptive Diagnostic Assessments**: Interactive quizzes that dynamically adjust difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard) and pinpoint knowledge gaps.
- **Step-by-Step Problem Solving**: Detailed mathematical and conceptual breakdowns with KaTeX LaTeX rendering for complex equations.
- **Active Recall Flashcards**: Spaced repetition flashcard decks for high-retention study.
- **Institutional Multi-Tenant Architecture**: Dedicated portals for School Administrators, Teachers, and Learners with strict tenant data isolation.
- **Curriculum Alignment**: Built to support Senior and Junior Secondary curricula (WAEC, NECO, and NERDC standards) across STEM, Humanities, and Commercial subjects.

## Key Modules & URLs
- [Home & Overview](https://ailearn.app/): Platform features, curriculum summary, and offline access guide.
- [School Curriculum](https://ailearn.app/subjects): Complete syllabus directory across Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English Language, Economics, and Financial Accounting.
- [General Knowledge Library](https://ailearn.app/general-knowledge): Open curriculum concepts, verified Q&A, and study guides.
- [Student & Faculty Portal](https://ailearn.app/login): Unified access for learners, teachers, and school administrators.

## Technical Architecture
- **Front-End**: React 19, TypeScript, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS v4, KaTeX.
- **Offline Storage**: Dexie.js (IndexedDB) with automatic background bi-directional sync upon reconnecting.
- **AI Integration**: Dual-engine architecture featuring Google Gemini when online and local intelligent educational heuristics when offline.
